title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement

---

## Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear description of what the problem is (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when ...").

## Describe the solution you'd like
What you want to happen.

## Context that helps us scope it
- **WP export size** this would affect (if relevant):
- **Theme(s)** this would affect (if relevant):
- Which part of the pipeline does this touch? (parser / transform / media / config codegen / rollback / CLI command)

## Describe alternatives you've considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've tried.

## Scope note
`@depress/core` and `@depress/wp-migrate` are the free, open-core packages. If this
feature is naturally a premium/paid capability, please say so — it may belong in a
separate package rather than core.

## Additional context
Anything else useful (links, mockups, example output).
